description: The bar chart illustrates the percentage of Pass@1 scores achieved by a 1B LLM (Large Language Model) compared to a 405B LLM across different test-time scaling scenarios. The horizontal axis represents the Pass@1 score, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, while the vertical axis indicates the percentage, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8. The chart features a single bar for each Pass@1 score, with the bar for a score of 0.0 being the shortest at 11.2%, and the bar for a score of 1.0 being the tallest at 76.2%. The mean Pass@1 score is indicated by a dashed line at 0.82. The bars are uniformly colored and there is no indication of sorting or emphasis on any particular bar.
